decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed third floor extension, by reason of its size, design, position and appearance would be unduly obtrusive and detract from the appearance of the existing building, the visual amenity of the street scene, and the visual amenity of Turnham Green. This would be contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Residential Extensions) and H.4.1 (Housing Standards) of the Council's Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The proposed third floor extension, by reason of its size, design, position and appearance would not preserve the character of Turnham Green Conservation Area. This would be contrary to policy ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the Council's Unitary Development Plan
description: Erection of a fourth storey extension to form a self contained flat above Public House.
